units.rawText: Freeze... Hey, aren't you that pink-haired pretty boy from just now?

spans.text: Freeze... Hey, aren't you that pink-haired pretty boy from just now?

units.rawText: Before Tony can react, the interrogator directs a series of furious kicks at him to vent his anger.
units.displayText: Before Tony can react, the interrogator directs a series of furious kicks at him to vent his anger.

spans.text: Before Tony can react, the interrogator directs a series of furious kicks at him to vent his anger.

units.rawText: All he can do is curl up and try not to let himself get hurt any further.
units.displayText: All he can do is curl up and try not to let himself get hurt any further.

spans.text: All he can do is curl up and try not to let himself get hurt any further.

units.rawText: It's all! Your fault! I went through! So much shit! Because of you!
units.displayText: It's all! Your fault! I went through! So much shit! Because of you!

spans.text: It's all! Your fault! I went through! So much shit! Because of you!

units.rawText: Warning: Chassis damage levels at 63%. Chassis is experiencing sustained hyperthermia; neural cloud module has been damaged...
units.displayText: Warning: Chassis damage levels at 63%. Chassis is experiencing sustained hyperthermia; neural cloud module has been damaged...

spans.text: Warning: Chassis damage levels at 63%. Chassis is experiencing sustained hyperthermia; neural cloud module has been damaged...

units.rawText: (Pants heavily)
units.displayText: Pants heavily

spans.text: Pants heavily

units.rawText: The vicious-looking man has tired himself out by kicking Tony. He grabs the latter's hair, clearly enjoying the look of misery on the luckless Doll's face.
units.displayText: The vicious-looking man has tired himself out by kicking Tony. He grabs the latter's hair, clearly enjoying the look of misery on the luckless Doll's face.

spans.text: The vicious-looking man has tired himself out by kicking Tony. He grabs the latter's hair, clearly enjoying the look of misery on the luckless Doll's face.

units.rawText: Still, that little gift of yours was most welcome.
units.displayText: Still, that little gift of yours was most welcome.

spans.text: Still, that little gift of yours was most welcome.

units.rawText: The familiar sight of the communicator flickers through Tony's blurred vision.
units.displayText: The familiar sight of the communicator flickers through Tony's blurred vision.

spans.text: The familiar sight of the communicator flickers through Tony's blurred vision.

units.rawText: You see that? You left that behind!
units.displayText: You see that? You left that behind!

spans.text: You see that? You left that behind!

units.rawText: We made sure to program our missiles to home in on the signals just so we could blow them up ASAP... Hehe, looks like it worked well.
units.displayText: We made sure to program our missiles to home in on the signals just so we could blow them up ASAP... Hehe, looks like it worked well.

spans.text: We made sure to program our missiles to home in on the signals just so we could blow them up ASAP... Hehe, looks like it worked well.

units.rawText: With this, catching all your friends will simply be a matter of time... I can't wait to have them in my interrogation room!
units.displayText: With this, catching all your friends will simply be a matter of time... I can't wait to have them in my interrogation room!

spans.text: With this, catching all your friends will simply be a matter of time... I can't wait to have them in my interrogation room!

units.rawText: Oh yes! I also learned something else!
units.displayText: Oh yes! I also learned something else!

spans.text: Oh yes! I also learned something else!

units.rawText: Remember that kid of Izka's we caught? Tsk, what was his name...
units.displayText: Remember that kid of Izka's we caught? Tsk, what was his name...

spans.text: Remember that kid of Izka's we caught? Tsk, what was his name...

units.rawText: Chr@#$is...
units.displayText: Chr@#$is...

spans.text: Chr@#$is...

units.rawText: That's right! His name was Chris, that punk...
units.displayText: That's right! His name was Chris, that punk...

spans.text: That's right! His name was Chris, that punk...

units.rawText: Tony can no longer make out what the interrogator is saying.
units.displayText: Tony can no longer make out what the interrogator is saying.

spans.text: Tony can no longer make out what the interrogator is saying.

units.rawText: With his neural cloud as badly damaged as it is, just staying conscious is all he can do.
units.displayText: With his neural cloud as badly damaged as it is, just staying conscious is all he can do.

spans.text: With his neural cloud as badly damaged as it is, just staying conscious is all he can do.

units.rawText: Are you okay, Tony?
units.displayText: Are you okay, Tony?

spans.text: Are you okay, Tony?

units.rawText: Lieutenant... Izka?
units.displayText: Lieutenant... Izka?

spans.text: Lieutenant... Izka?

units.rawText: Sorry I got you caught up in all this Tony. Just look at what's become of you.
units.displayText: Sorry I got you caught up in all this Tony. Just look at what's become of you.

spans.text: Sorry I got you caught up in all this Tony. Just look at what's become of you.

units.rawText: ...Looks like my memory module is starting to throw up errors. I didn't expect the last thing I saw before I crashed to be you.
units.displayText: ...Looks like my memory module is starting to throw up errors. I didn't expect the last thing I saw before I crashed to be you.

spans.text: ...Looks like my memory module is starting to throw up errors. I didn't expect the last thing I saw before I crashed to be you.

units.rawText: Hm? What are you muttering about?
units.displayText: Hm? What are you muttering about?

spans.text: Hm? What are you muttering about?

units.rawText: No, it's nothing. I'm sorry I couldn't keep the promise I made to you... Hey!
units.displayText: No, it's nothing. I'm sorry I couldn't keep the promise I made to you... Hey!

spans.text: No, it's nothing. I'm sorry I couldn't keep the promise I made to you... Hey!

units.rawText: Lieutenant Izka cuts Tony off and reaches out to pat his head.
units.displayText: Lieutenant Izka cuts Tony off and reaches out to pat his head.

spans.text: Lieutenant Izka cuts Tony off and reaches out to pat his head.

units.rawText: What the hell... You're messing up my hair.
units.displayText: What the hell... You're messing up my hair.

spans.text: What the hell... You're messing up my hair.

units.rawText: You've done well, Tony. The Commander is a trustworthy person. Leave the rest to them.
units.displayText: You've done well, Tony. The Commander is a trustworthy person. Leave the rest to them.

spans.text: You've done well, Tony. The Commander is a trustworthy person. Leave the rest to them.

units.rawText: ...Yeah.
units.displayText: ...Yeah.

spans.text: ...Yeah.

units.rawText: You don't have much time left, Tony. Thank you for your hard work. Now go get some rest.
units.displayText: You don't have much time left, Tony. Thank you for your hard work. Now go get some rest.

spans.text: You don't have much time left, Tony. Thank you for your hard work. Now go get some rest.

units.rawText: He doesn't say anything else, only extends his hand to Tony in invitation.
units.displayText: He doesn't say anything else, only extends his hand to Tony in invitation.

spans.text: He doesn't say anything else, only extends his hand to Tony in invitation.

units.rawText: I'm sorry, I can't do that.
units.displayText: I'm sorry, I can't do that.

spans.text: I'm sorry, I can't do that.

units.rawText: Izka, I don't want to betray the Commander's trust. I can't go with you while the mission isn't complete.
units.displayText: Izka, I don't want to betray the Commander's trust. I can't go with you while the mission isn't complete.

spans.text: Izka, I don't want to betray the Commander's trust. I can't go with you while the mission isn't complete.

units.rawText: The lieutenant before him smiles slowly, as though he'd already known this answer was coming, and he salutes Tony.
units.displayText: The lieutenant before him smiles slowly, as though he'd already known this answer was coming, and he salutes Tony.

spans.text: The lieutenant before him smiles slowly, as though he'd already known this answer was coming, and he salutes Tony.

units.rawText: ...It's only been a while since we last saw each other, but damn if you haven't changed.
units.displayText: ...It's only been a while since we last saw each other, but damn if you haven't changed.

spans.text: ...It's only been a while since we last saw each other, but damn if you haven't changed.

units.rawText: All the best, soldier.
units.displayText: All the best, soldier.

spans.text: All the best, soldier.

units.rawText: What, is that it? Tsk, there's no fun in torturing you tin cans when you can't even scream in pain!
units.displayText: What, is that it? Tsk, there's no fun in torturing you tin cans when you can't even scream in pain!

spans.text: What, is that it? Tsk, there's no fun in torturing you tin cans when you can't even scream in pain!

units.rawText: He kicks Tony a few times, but Tony does not react. Then, he decides to leave and seek more amusing prey.
units.displayText: He kicks Tony a few times, but Tony does not react. Then, he decides to leave and seek more amusing prey.

spans.text: He kicks Tony a few times, but Tony does not react. Then, he decides to leave and seek more amusing prey.

units.rawText: Suddenly, something grabs his pant leg.
units.displayText: Suddenly, something grabs his pant leg.

spans.text: Suddenly, something grabs his pant leg.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: It is a ruin of a hand with exposed cabling everywhere.
units.displayText: It is a ruin of a hand with exposed cabling everywhere.

spans.text: It is a ruin of a hand with exposed cabling everywhere.

units.rawText: These were once Tony the hairdresser's pride and joy.
units.displayText: These were once Tony the hairdresser's pride and joy.

spans.text: These were once Tony the hairdresser's pride and joy.

units.rawText: Tsk, are you going to stick to me until the end?
units.displayText: Tsk, are you going to stick to me until the end?

spans.text: Tsk, are you going to stick to me until the end?

units.rawText: Just as the interrogator tries to struggle free, the lump of ruined metal before him suddenly exerts itself and his weighty frame crashes heavily to the ground.
units.displayText: Just as the interrogator tries to struggle free, the lump of ruined metal before him suddenly exerts itself and his weighty frame crashes heavily to the ground.

spans.text: Just as the interrogator tries to struggle free, the lump of ruined metal before him suddenly exerts itself and his weighty frame crashes heavily to the ground.

units.rawText: Before the interrogator can respond, Tony has already taken back what belongs to him and pressed the button on it.
units.displayText: Before the interrogator can respond, Tony has already taken back what belongs to him and pressed the button on it.

spans.text: Before the interrogator can respond, Tony has already taken back what belongs to him and pressed the button on it.

units.rawText: Click! Beep—
units.displayText: Click! Beep—

spans.text: Click! Beep—

units.rawText: <size=50>AIIIIIEEEEEEE!!!! NO! NOOOOOOO!!!!!!</size>
units.displayText: AIIIIIEEEEEEE!!!! NO! NOOOOOOO!!!!!!

spans.text: AIIIIIEEEEEEE!!!! NO! NOOOOOOO!!!!!!

units.rawText: The ruthless missiles come crashing down again. This time, they accomplish their mission.
units.displayText: The ruthless missiles come crashing down again. This time, they accomplish their mission.

spans.text: The ruthless missiles come crashing down again. This time, they accomplish their mission.

units.rawText: Kaboom—
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: Smoke and dust fill the air, the radio station collapses with a crash, while smoke and firelight rise above the city's skyline...
units.displayText: Smoke and dust fill the air, the radio station collapses with a crash, while smoke and firelight rise above the city's skyline...

spans.text: Smoke and dust fill the air, the radio station collapses with a crash, while smoke and firelight rise above the city's skyline...

units.rawText: He is buried under the cold debris. That day, the defenders managed to retreat unscathed thanks to the timely warning.
units.displayText: He is buried under the cold debris. That day, the defenders managed to retreat unscathed thanks to the timely warning.

spans.text: He is buried under the cold debris. That day, the defenders managed to retreat unscathed thanks to the timely warning.

units.rawText: The after-action report from HQ bears only one sentence: No casualties sustained.
units.displayText: The after-action report from HQ bears only one sentence: No casualties sustained.

spans.text: The after-action report from HQ bears only one sentence: No casualties sustained.
